content.title: Storrs – Main Campus – Undergraduate Admissions
content.text: Located in the heart of the northeast halfway between New York City and Boston, UConn’s main campus in Storrs makes for an energizing and inspiring environment. Here, our students learn alongside esteemed professors, student-scholars, and talented peers. With over 700 clubs and organizations to choose from, 21 NCAA Division I athletic teams to cheer on, and one of the highest percentages of students living on campus of any public university, there’s plenty to do with friends on a night off from hitting the books. The six cultural centers and programs on campus serve as resources for our richly diverse and inclusive campus community comprised of more than 80 different countries. And if exploration is what interests you, choose from over 200 experiential global learning and study abroad opportunities including internships, field work, and research programs. Explore more: Class of 2029 at Storrs Main Campus 62,000+ first-year applicants across all campuses ≈550 Huskies enrolled in the highly selective Honors Program 70+ countries and 41 U.S. states are represented by our students. 4,750 enrolled first-year Huskies 47% of entering first-year Huskies are in the top 10% of their senior classes 28% of first-year Huskies are first-generation students Institutional Codes SAT – 3915ACT – 0604 Combined SAT*1320 – 1460Combined ACT*30 – 34 *Middle 50% of Admitted Students Standardized test ranges represent the middle 50% of fall 2025 admitted students who elected to submit test scores as part of their application materials. UConn is a test-optional institution through fall 2026. United by pride, excellence flourishes across our five campuses throughout Connecticut.
